name: Forum meetups

card.summary: In-person get-togethers arranged between looksmaxxing forum members, which give users a way to compare appearances, swap advice and see each other's results face to face.
card.note: Meetups are informal and user-organised; members typically know one another only by username.

quick.overview:
Forum meetups are in-person gatherings organised by members of looksmaxxing forums such as looksmax.org. Members use forum threads to propose a date and city, and others reply to say whether they will attend.

For appearance, the appeal described in threads is seeing how members actually look in person, as opposed to in photos, and meeting people who share the same interests in grooming, fitness and style. Threads span regional gatherings and posts about running into other members by chance.
quick.how: A member starts a thread naming a city, country or region and a date, others respond with interest, and details move to private messages. Threads from 2020 onward include proposed national meetups, a Copenhagen meetup dated 24 November 2023, and regional threads for Michigan, India and the UK.
quick.risks: Meetups bring together people who know each other mainly through usernames, so the ordinary cautions about meeting online contacts in person apply. Some threads treat the idea jokingly and others are announcements that never visibly led to an event.

lead: Forum meetups are in-person gatherings arranged between members of looksmaxxing forums, most visibly looksmax.org, where members refer to them as an "org meetup" or "looksmax meetup".[1][2]

In the forum's culture, appearance is usually discussed through photographs and rating threads. A meetup lets members see each other's height, build, grooming and style in person, which several threads treat as a point of interest in itself.[3]

Meetup threads recur over several years, from 2020 "official" meetup threads to regional proposals for Michigan, India, the UK and Denmark.[1][2][4][5][6] Many are short and consist of expressions of interest rather than reports of events.

chain: Members arrange to meet in person
They compare grooming, fitness and style in real life
Members get direct, in-person feedback and ideas
angle.text: Meetups give members a chance to see how looks, height and style translate outside photos, and to exchange grooming, fitness and clothing tips face to face. The benefit is social and informational rather than a direct change to anyone's appearance.

paras: A forum meetup begins with a thread in which a member proposes a gathering in a given city or region. Replies state whether others live nearby or would travel, and arrangements are usually moved into private messages.[2][3]

Threads exist at several scales: global or national "official" meetups such as the 2020 spring and 2020 threads, city-level posts such as the Copenhagen meetup announced for Friday 24 November 2023, and country or state groupings such as Michigan, India and the UK.[4][5][6][7][8]

Members describe meetups in different tones: some propose them seriously as a way to meet other users, while others pose them with humour, such as one UK thread that jokes about making a TikTok of the event.[3] A thread titled by a member who "came across" a meetup in a local supermarket shows that stories about meeting members by chance are also shared.[9]
Threads also ask whether a meetup has ever taken place and describe what an "average" one might look like, suggesting the idea is a recurring topic of conversation as well as an activity.[10][11]

timeline.event: "Official looksmax meetup" threads appear on looksmax.org.[7][8]
A Copenhagen meetup is proposed for 24 November 2023.[5]
